verdict.rationale: Square documents a Disputes API ('Process Disputes'), a general Webhooks system, and an official MCP server, so an agent can plausibly read dispute data and get event notifications. The evidence is only page titles, though, so it is not shown that deadlines are exposed, that dispute-specific webhook events exist, or that evidence can be uploaded or submitted via API for a human-review workflow. Missing for 10: documented dispute due-date fields, dispute webhook event types, evidence upload/submit endpoints, MCP coverage of disputes, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
